components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Rust primary action for the one main action in a local area.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.5625rem; background: var(--primary, #b85a32); color: var(--primary-foreground, #fbf7ed); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, #b85a32) 90%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, #b85a32); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #b85a32) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Calm secondary action for navigation, confirmation, and low-drama controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; border: 1px solid var(--border, #ddd0be); border-radius: 0.5625rem; background: var(--card, #fbf7ed); color: var(--foreground, #182536); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted, #ebe3d6); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, #b85a32); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #b85a32) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Low-chroma destructive action used only with explicit consequence copy.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.5625rem; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--destructive, #a33d2e) 10%, transparent); color: var(--destructive, #a33d2e); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--destructive, #a33d2e) 20%, transparent); } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--destructive, #a33d2e) 40%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--destructive, #a33d2e) 20%, transparent); }

components.name: Roster Field
components.description: Shared labeled field for roster, review, settings, and operator forms.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.375rem; color: var(--foreground, #182536); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--border, #ddd0be); border-radius: var(--radius, 0.5rem); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--background, #f3eadc) 50%, transparent); color: var(--foreground, #182536); font: inherit; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, #5d554a); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring, #b85a32); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #b85a32) 20%, transparent); }

components.name: Paper Work Surface
components.description: One dominant paper surface for active capture or evidence work.
components.html:
What happened?

Capture one student-specific observation, then review it before saving.
components.css: .ds-paper-surface { max-width: 390px; padding: 1.25rem; border: 1px solid var(--border, #ddd0be); border-radius: var(--radius-card, 1.125rem); background: var(--card, #fbf7ed); color: var(--foreground, #182536); box-shadow: var(--shadow-paper, 0 3px 8px rgba(31, 25, 17, 0.12)); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-paper-surface h3 { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; font-family: Fraunces, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.4; font-weight: 600; } .ds-paper-surface p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted-foreground, #5d554a); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.625; }

components.name: Evidence Chip
components.description: Quiet organizational chip for evidence type, tags, and structured fields.
components.css: .ds-evidence-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; max-width: 100%; padding: 0.125rem 0.625rem; border: 1px solid var(--border, #ddd0be); border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--muted, #ebe3d6) 60%, transparent); color: var(--link, #2c526f); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.5; font-weight: 500; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: Compact authenticated navigation with explicit current-page state.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border-radius: 0.5625rem; color: var(--muted-foreground, #5d554a); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--muted, #ebe3d6) 60%, transparent); color: var(--foreground, #182536); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #b85a32) 20%, transparent); } .ds-nav-item-active { color: var(--foreground, #182536); } .ds-nav-item-active::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0.75rem; right: 0.75rem; bottom: -0.75rem; height: 2px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--primary, #b85a32); }

narrative.overview:
ClassTrace should feel like a well-kept evidence ledger open on a teacher's desk: humane without being themed, structured without becoming institutional, and quiet enough that the observation remains the most important thing on the screen. Warm paper tones soften the working environment while ink-forward type, rules, and ledger rows make saved evidence easy to scan and trust.

This is product UI, so familiarity is an asset. Controls use standard affordances, interaction state is explicit, and motion communicates change rather than decorating it. The system rejects enterprise-dashboard density, decorative classroom imagery, generic teacher-notebook styling, and card-grid analytics. On mobile, controls stack or wrap; on desktop, width supports scanning rather than adding panels.
keyCharacteristics: Capture-first hierarchy with one prominent working surface.
Evidence-led ledgers separated by rules instead of interchangeable card grids.
Warm paper, dark ink, rare rust action, and sage validation.
Familiar controls with visible focus, explicit error, and reduced-motion states.
Compact teacher language with no invented analytics or automation concepts.

rules.name: The Rust Rarity Rule
rules.body: Rust belongs to primary actions, active indicators, and focus states. If rust appears everywhere, the hierarchy is broken.

rules.name: The Validation Is Sage Rule
rules.body: Validated evidence uses sage plus explicit text or iconography. Never substitute loud success green, blue information styling, or gold celebration.

rules.name: The No Rainbow Tags Rule
rules.body: Tags organize evidence; they are not decoration. Use the shared muted, bordered chip vocabulary.

rules.name: The Labels Stay Sans Rule
rules.body: Buttons, form labels, navigation, metadata, and data use Inter. Fraunces never appears inside a working control.

rules.name: The Evidence Reads First Rule
rules.body: Teacher-approved evidence uses the primary ink color at 15px with relaxed leading. Supporting structure steps down to the metadata role.

rules.name: The Border-First Rule
rules.body: If a border or divider explains the relationship, use it and stop. Shadow is reserved for active paper separation.

rules.name: The One Lifted Surface Rule
rules.body: A workflow may have one dominant lifted surface. Nested shadows and stacks of floating cards are forbidden.

dos: Do keep capture visually primary and ask for exactly one student.
Do render evidence and roster data as ledgers when scanning matters.
Do use the semantic roles declared in app/globals.css.
Do reserve rust for primary action, current state, and focus hierarchy.
Do pair sage validation with the word “Validated” or a meaningful icon.
Do use familiar controls, visible labels, AA contrast, named landmarks, non-color state cues, and reduced-motion alternatives.
Do keep archive calmer and easier to choose than permanent delete.
Do use direct teacher language: Capture, What happened?, Review before saving, Evidence note, Student, Class, Tags, Follow-up, Timeline, and Report.
donts: Don't make ClassTrace look like an enterprise dashboard, a decorative classroom theme, a generic teacher notebook, or a card-grid analytics product.
Don't borrow surveillance, compliance, automation, or AI-product language.
Don't use ornamental school imagery, fake controls, dashboard metrics, glass effects, gradient text, noisy textures, excessive cards, or invented affordances that compete with capture and review.
Don't create decorative motion, orchestrated product-page entrances, broad transition-all, or motion without a reduced-motion alternative.
Don't use colored side stripes, giant soft shadows, nested cards, or radii larger than the established card token.
Don't introduce a one-off button, input, chip, evidence, or confirmation vocabulary when a shared pattern exists.
Don't imply classwide capture, multiple-student evidence, file handling, generative interpretation, analytics, or other unapproved product scope.
